description: Gives a model the official iLang: the runtime a model loads (about 18,600 tokens, verified against the canon's sha256), the full text for any section it leaves out, the canon grammar validator, and lookup over the dictionary and the ilang.ai FAQ. Read-only, no authentication.

tools.name: ilang_runtime
tools.description: Load the official iLang runtime, once per conversation; media=true adds the media extension.

tools.name: ilang_full
tools.description: Read a section of the full specification that the core runtime leaves out, by heading.

tools.name: ilang_validate
tools.description: Check iLang text with the canon grammar and registry validator.

tools.name: ilang_lookup
tools.description: Look up an iLang verb, modifier, entity or declaration by name, alias or meaning.

tools.name: ilang_faq
tools.description: Return the published FAQ entry closest to a question about the iLang protocol.

prompts.name: ilang
prompts.description: Put the official iLang runtime in the conversation.
